title: SignalHQ
summary: Anonymous feedback for teams. Organisations share no-signup links, an AI anonymity guard warns people before a detail gives them away, and teams triage, reply and measure what comes back.
highlights: AI anonymity guard that flags identifying details in a draft ("the only designer on the team") and suggests a safer rewrite before it's sent
Anonymous two-way threads: teams reply, and the sender can follow up through a private receipt link without ever revealing who they are
Rating, NPS and poll questions with response caps and close dates, plus a triage inbox and click-to-filter analytics

details.label: Anonymous, but actually safe
details.body: Responders never need an account. The anonymity guard catches the role, project or timing details that would narrow a message down to one person, and it never stores or logs the draft. Submissions pass moderation and rate limits before they reach the team.

details.label: AI where it helps
details.body: Built on Mistral through one isolated module with per-organisation quotas: incoming messages get sentiment and tags, and the platform offers semantic search, question summaries, reply drafts and an AI daily digest. Toxicity and PII flags are only shown to owners and admins.

details.label: An inbox teams can work
details.body: Per-person read state, archive, labels and assignment, plus analytics charts for volume, sentiment and NPS. Clicking any chart segment filters the inbox to the messages behind it.

details.label: Multi-tenant by design
details.body: Organisations, teams and role-based permissions (owner, admin, member), email invitations, QR share links, and custom branding (logo, accent colour, welcome text) on the public pages for paid plans.
